Package model.gameObjects

Class HeartContainerObject

java.lang.Object
model.Entity
model.GameObject
model.gameObjects.HeartContainerObject
All Implemented Interfaces:
Interactable, Purchasable
public class HeartContainerObject extends GameObject implements Interactable, Purchasable
The class representing a heart container, which grants the player 2 extra maximum life. It implements the Interactable interface to allow player interaction, and the Purchasable interface to allow buying.

    • HeartContainerObject

      public HeartContainerObject(String id, int x, int y, int price, String[] dialogue)
      Generates a heart container. It also sets its area and its collisions as true, blocking player movement.
      Parameters:
      id - the id needed to identify the entity
      x - position on the x axis
      y - position on the y axis
      price - the item's price
      dialogue - the lines of dialogue required for the shop interaction
